d:
The Centre is considering setting up a special committee to review the UGC Equity Regulations 2026 after the Supreme Court raised concerns over their provisions. The rules, aimed at preventing caste-based discrimination in colleges and universities, faced criticism over the protection of general category students and the possibility of misuse. The Supreme Court stayed their implementation in January 2026. What is the controversy, and what happens next?
